# The world an interleaving builds

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-world-an-interleaving-builds` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-world-an-interleaving-builds.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> From a local law and a list of exchanges a World of the spine is built whose steps balance. Two interleavings of the same courses, every exchange touching a relatum, are carried one to the other by one renumbering of the steps, under which what is read at a step on what its exchange touches agrees.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The configuration after the first t exchanges of a list changes across step t by the exchange at t, is the whole list's from its length on, is unchanged up to a list's length by appending, is after a list the rest's from where the list ends, and agrees where the starts agree. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_succ`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_whole`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_append_le`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_append`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_agree`)
2. The world of a local law on whole-number standings, the relata listed, a list and a start: at step t each relatum stands where the first t exchanges leave it, is active where the exchange at t touches it (decided: touchAt), and the move at t has present the listed relata it touches, each taking its fall and giving its rise; nothing is required, needed or drawn. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.fall`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.rise`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_level`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_mem`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_not_mem`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_mem_of`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_pairwise`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.total_zero_of`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.total_single`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.total_absent`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchAt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_active_iff`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchAt_some`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchAt_none`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchAt_iff`)
3. With every relatum listed once, every step of the world balances: the standing after the step with what the relatum took is the standing before with what it gave. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_balances`)
4. A relatum's course of standings is its standing after each exchange of its own course, in order. Moving an exchange forward past exchanges sharing no relatum with it keeps every course of standings, so with the relata listed two lists giving every relatum the same own course, and two interleavings of the same courses, give every relatum the same course of standings. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_true`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_false`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_agree`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_move`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_idle`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_of_courses`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_of_interleavings`)
5. With the relata listed, the worlds of two lists giving every relatum the same own course stand alike at every step from both lengths on. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_final`)
6. Two adjacent exchanges sharing no relatum, taken in either order, leave the worlds alike at every step but the one between them; there a relatum the first touches stands, in the world taking it first, where it stands after both in the other, and where it stood before both in the other; one neither touches stands alike. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_swap`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_swap_between`)
7. A relatum's standing at step t of a list is its standing after the own exchanges the first t exchanges hold (ownCount, standingAfter). So in two interleavings of the same courses, with the relata listed, a relatum stands alike at any two steps, one in each world, at which it has taken equally many of its own exchanges. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standingAfter`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_true`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_false`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_zero`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standingAfter_of_interleavings`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_of_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_of_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.afterOwn`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.afterOwn_zero`)
8. The index map for a relatum sends a step of one list to the least step of the other at which the relatum has taken as many of its own exchanges (firstAt is that least step; ownCount_index); a relatum stands at step t of one world where it stands at the mapped step of the other. Where it takes an exchange at step t of one list, the map sends t + 1 to the step after the one at which it takes the same exchange in the other. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_le`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_true`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_false`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_firstAt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_least`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.indexMap`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.length_of_interleavings`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_index`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_index`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_index`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_lt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_succ_step`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.index_matches`)
9. What is read through a relatum's own steps is the same for every interleaving: for every property of a standing, a relatum has it at some step of one world exactly where at some step of the other, and at every step of one exactly where at every step of the other. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_reads_alike`)
10. Where every exchange of two interleavings of the same courses touches some relatum (Touching), with the relata listed, the lists have one length, and where one has an exchange at step t the other has the same exchange at exactly one step at which every relatum it touches has taken as many of its own exchanges: the k-th taking of an exchange in one is the k-th in the other at every relatum it touches. The renumbering sends t there (read off the first listed relatum the exchange touches; every relatum it touches gives the same step), and for each such relatum its index map sends t + 1 to the step after. It is undone by the renumbering the other way at every step, sends the steps below the length among themselves and fixes every step from the length on, so the two renumberings Reindex the steps (Becoming.Reordering). (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_mem`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_append_lt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_append`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_beyond`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_none`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_some`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.length_insert`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_append_le`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_append`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_untouched`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_mono`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.step_of_ownCount`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_after`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.occurrence_matches`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.Touching`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.Touching.tail`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.Touching.remove`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.length_of_courses`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touches_of_touchedIn`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_none`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_lead`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_spec`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_exchange`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_count`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_index`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_renumber`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_beyond`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_lt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_reindexes`)
11. Through the renumbering the worlds agree: a relatum is active at step t of one exactly where it is active at the renumbered step of the other, for every relatum at every step; the step takes the same exchange (the same relata present, each taking and giving the same: Flow.SameExchange); and every relatum the exchange touches stands alike before it and after it. So every relation read at one step on the relata its exchange touches, however many, holds at step t of one world exactly where at the renumbered step of the other; this holds for any states, not only whole-number standings. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchAt_renumber`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_untouched`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_renumber`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.reads_renumber`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.change_renumber`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_renumber_active`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_renumber_level`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_renumber_reads`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.fall_of_change`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.rise_of_change`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_renumber_flow`)
12. The correspondence with Becoming.Reordering: the renumbering keeps the order of exchanges sharing a relatum (Keeps, for the footprint of the touches, in which two exchanges are joined exactly where they touch a relatum in common), and that footprint moves with it. It contains the exchanges exactly where no relatum is touched at a step after one not touching it, the world's activity being taking part in the exchange across a step. The footprint around each step, what the exchange at it or at the next touches, contains them, activity included, but joins every two consecutive exchanges, so the only renumbering of the steps keeping its order fixes every step: Reordering's commutations relate the world of an interleaving to no other interleaving's world, and the relation between them is the renumbering. On the worlds, world_renumber_correspondence gathers the premises of Reordering's converse the renumbering meets: the reindexing (fixing every step from the length on), the kept order, the same exchange at the renumbered step and the moved footprint. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.footprinted`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchAround`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.bool_or_false_left`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.bool_or_false_right`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.bool_or_of_left`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.bool_or_of_right`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.untouched_unmoved`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touch_contains_iff`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.around_contains`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.around_joined`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.keeps_consecutive`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.around_keeps_identity`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.renumber_keeps`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_renumber_correspondence`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A local law on whole-number standings for the world (the laws of own steps hold for any states); the relata listed, once where balance is stated; relata told apart for the move. The courses are finite lists.
- For the renumbering: every exchange of both lists touches some relatum (Touching), and the relata are listed. Without the first an exchange touching no relatum has no match (Pair.idle_unmatched).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- A relation read at one step on relata the step's exchange does not touch: what stands together there is the chosen interleaving's, and no renumbering carries it (Pair.apart_differs).
- A reading of activity as a relatum's state between steps, under which Reordering's commutations could relate two interleavings' worlds; here activity is taking part in the exchange across a step, so the touch footprint contains the exchanges only in the case touch_contains_iff states and the footprint around each step orders every two consecutive steps.
- Courses without end; footprints that read relata they do not change; exchanges touching no relatum.
- **Counterexample:** Interleavings.Pair.apart_differs: [0, 1] and [1, 0] interleave the same courses of two relata no exchange connects, and the renumbering exchanges their steps; at step 1 of the first world one relatum stands below the other, and at no step of the second does. A relation read at one step on relata the step's exchange does not touch is not the same for every interleaving. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interleavings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Interleavings.Pair.touch_not_contains: in the world of [0, 1] the footprint of the touches does not contain the exchanges: the relatum true is untouched at step 0 and touched at step 1, so its activity changes across a step not touching it. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interleavings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Interleavings.Pair.idle_unmatched: [2] and [] give every relatum the same own course, while [2] has at step 0 an exchange touching no relatum that [] has at no step: without Touching there is no renumbering of the steps matching the exchanges. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interleavings.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The twentieth review's G10 asked that Interleavings, which reads the step index off the relata's own courses, construct the World, so that one shared index is a reading on the premise card. Reading (the AI's): the spine's World, with its one index, is what an interleaving of the relata's own courses builds; what the interleaving adds beyond the courses moves only where exchanges share no relatum, and there each relatum stands in one world where it stands a step earlier or later in the other. With the index map (R38), what the world says of each relatum, read through its own steps, is the same for every interleaving: the premise card's one shared index (§0, block A) commits, for what is read per relatum, to no more than a choice among interleavings, which moves where on the index a standing falls and not which standings a relatum passes through or in what order. For the necessity target (the deductive necessity of the whole, item 1 of §8.1, and the representation criterion K4) this makes the shared index a reading wherever a law is read through each relatum's own steps; With one renumbering of all the steps (R46), the same holds of every law read at one step on the relata that step's exchange touches, however many: the shared index is a reading for it as well. What remains a commitment of the representation is exactly which relata that no exchange at a step relates stand together there, and Pair.apart_differs shows that this is not carried by any renumbering: it is the choice of interleaving itself, not a gap in the proof. For the necessity target this narrows the index's part of item 1 of §8.1 and of K4 to laws reading, at one step, relata no exchange there relates; and since Reordering's commutations relate no two interleavings' worlds (activity being taking part in the exchange across a step), the renumbering, not a commutation, is the relation between them.

### History

- 20 October 2026: added (R33, G10 of the twentieth review, interleavings build the World): the construction, its balance, the course of standings and the end shared by interleavings of the same courses, and the adjacent swap; the general step-by-step relation is open (study section 224).
- 20 October 2026, R38 (the open part of R33's G10): three laws added (the standing at a step as the standing after own exchanges, so equal own counts stand alike across interleavings; the index map, its exactness and its matching of each relatum's exchanges; the readings through own steps the same for every interleaving), the general step-by-step relation thus proved directly rather than by composing adjacent swaps; the open part restated as one renumbering of the steps and the correspondence with Reordering's footprint, with its blocker; what the relation gives the necessity target and the premise card added to the correspondence. Proof binding (Interleavings.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261020T070914.793352Z. Study section 233.
- 20 October 2026, R46 (the open part R38 left): three laws added (one renumbering of all the steps, matching each taking of an exchange at every relatum it touches, each such relatum's index map one step back, a Reindexes of the steps; activity, the exchange and the standings of what it touches agreeing through it, so every relation read at one step on those relata agrees; the correspondence with Reordering: the touch footprint's order kept, its containment exactly characterized, and the footprint around each step containing the exchanges but leaving only the identity renumbering), the premise Touching, three counterexamples, a dependency on order-of-exchanges-is-the-invariant; the world's activity restated as the decided touch (touchAt), equivalent to the earlier form (world_active_iff); the open parts replaced by what stays open; the correspondence's last sentence rewritten. Proof binding (Interleavings.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261020T101723.692082Z. Study section 252.
